peak_voltage.root_cause: Anti-aliasing polyphase FIR filter boundary transient (Gibbs ringing) at t=0 on Phase C during resample(Vabc, t, 5000). Steady-state peak after t > 5 ms is 0.8313 pu across both environments.

crest_factor.root_cause: Direct mathematical consequence of the Phase C filter startup peak (0.8951 pu vs 0.5824 raw RMS yields 1.5369 on Phase C; 3-phase mean is 1.4552). Continuous signal achieves exact sqrt(2) = 1.414213.

thd.root_cause: Triple-factor discrepancy: (1) Phase selection: MATLAB evaluates Phase A only, Python averages all 3 phases (PhA: 0.12%, PhB: 0.12%, PhC: 0.24% -> mean 0.1608%); (2) Continuous FFT smearing: MATLAB raw reference ran uniform FFT on non-uniform variable-step points across 225,334 samples, diluting harmonic bin power to noise floor (~10^-6); (3) Harmonic range: MATLAB H2-H50 vs Python H2-H11. On the identical resampled Phase A data, MATLAB FFT and Python Goertzel harmonic magnitudes match to 6 decimal places (H1=0.833215, H2=0.000371, H3=0.000374, H4=0.000376, H5=0.000378).
